Local history collections

About this place

The collection includes old maps of Bikrampur, photographs of regional monuments and excavated objects such as terracotta pipes, vessels and toys. Galleries recall the life of Jagadish Chandra Bose, the Jadunath Roy estate and the Liberation War. Pair Balasur with nearby Rarikhal for a visit centred on Sreenagar’s heritage.

Confirm admission and opening arrangements with the venue before departure.
